input.quote: 18.1 Vendor shall maintain, at its own expense throughout the term and for one year afterward, commercial general liability insurance of at least USD 1,000,000 per occurrence and USD 2,000,000 aggregate, workers' compensation as required by law, employer's liability of USD 1,000,000, professional errors and omissions insurance of USD 2,000,000, and cyber and privacy liability insurance of USD 5,000,000.
input.rationale: Section 18 contains a full vendor insurance clause that meets our preferred position: CGL at USD 1M per occurrence / USD 2M aggregate, professional E&O at USD 2M, cyber and privacy liability at USD 5M (appropriate for a hosting vendor processing our health data), and workers' compensation as required by law, all maintained for the term plus one year, with employer's liability of USD 1M as an extra. Section 18.2 adds certificates of insurance on request, reputable insurers, primacy, cancellation notice, and confirmation that insurance does not cap Vendor's liability. Obligations run against Vendor and benefit us, so no redline is warranted.
